scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Education- Haryana Silicosis Board
other_conditions: The worker must be suffering from silicosis as confirmed by the Silicosis Diagnosis Board, Haryana
The worker must be registered with the Haryana Silicosis Board
Children must be studying in any class from Class I up to Master's Degree
Assistance is available for up to two boys and up to three girls per affected worker, irrespective of birth order
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹5,000–₹12,000 per year is provided to children of affected workers studying from Class I to Master's Degree.
documents_required: certificate of being the widow/widower or nominee (if applicable)
